thread:
Miri: Hey folks — impromptu hybrid LAN this Friday evening in the garage? Bring consoles/handhelds. I'll roast coffee :coffee:
Alex: Love it. I can bring my Steam Deck and a power bank.
Dillon: I have an ethernet switch (8-port) and a couple of patch cables.
Jamie: Projector available — needs an HDMI adapter. What time?
Miri: Thinking 7pm start, open until ~11. RSVP poll below, also raffle for a power strip. Bring snacks.
Alex: Friday works. Can bring spare dock and USB-C hub.
Chris: Sat would be easier for me :hand:; if Friday's worse I can try to swap.
Miri: can folks mark Friday/Sat in thread? I'll tally.
Jamie: I'll volunteer to be tech lead for network. @Dillon can you put the switch on 10.0.50.1/24? we'll run NAT on my mac.
Dillon: Yep. I'll bring labeled cables. Also I'll bring a surge protector.
ops-bot: Reminder: Please keep laptops charged and don't plug into server rack. :robot_face: 
Alex: anyone bringing old controllers? I have two extra Xbox wired pads.
Miri: also maybe a "weird controller" mini prize — whoever shows up with the strangest input device wins a sticker.
Chris: I can bring a GameCube adapter and a retro CRT (small). Need help hauling.
Jamie: I've got a cart and 2 hands. :thumbsup:
Sam: I'll bring ethernet tape and a labeler.
Miri: cool — tally so far: Alex (Steam Deck + dock), Dillon (switch + cables + surge), Jamie (projector + cart), Chris (CRT + GC adapter), Miri (coffee + snacks + stickers), Sam (tape + labels). Anyone else?
ops-bot: Signup form closes in 48h if >20 people. Link: https://forms.gle/example
Alex: small note — if you need to stream, use `rtmp://jamie.local:1935/live` and password 'redwoodplay' — Jamie will open ports.
Jamie: will set up local .htpasswd for streams.
Miri: thanks all. Final reminder Friday 12pm. See you!
